preconditions.description: The starting row index sr is within the bounds of the image.
The starting column index sc is within the bounds of the image.
The new color is within the valid pixel value range.

postconditions.description: The output image has the same number of rows as the input image.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(output[i]) for i, row in enumerate(image))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output image has the same number of columns as the corresponding row in the input image.

postconditions.expression: all(all(output[i][j] == newColor or output[i][j] != image[sr][sc] for j in range(len(image[0]))) for i in range(len(image)))
postconditions.description: All pixels connected 4-directionally to the starting pixel, including the starting pixel itself, are colored with the new color. Pixels not connected to the starting pixel are unchanged.
